principles: Masculine identity comes from article construction, proportion, layering, and styling rather than darkness or shoulder width.
One dominant construction gesture is supported by at most two subordinate surface systems.
Front-specific detail terminates at seams while collars, yokes, stripes, ribbing, and belts wrap only when physically coherent.
Extra logical pixels clarify lapels, plackets, pockets, cuffs, panels, and motifs before they add shading.
A design that becomes an empty torso without shading fails.

CASUAL.shoulders: standard and relaxed rather than padded
CASUAL.necklineCollar: crew, henley, or restrained casual collar
CASUAL.trimPatternMotif: small stripe, placket, or compact personal motif
CASUAL.colorBlocking: light and colorful options are normal
CASUAL.directionRule: front placket disappears; neckline and hem persist
CASUAL.identityWithoutColor: short placket plus simple balanced proportions

WORKWEAR_FARMWEAR.pocketsPanels: paired chest pockets and back yoke
WORKWEAR_FARMWEAR.trimPatternMotif: utility seams, modest checks, no floating ornament
WORKWEAR_FARMWEAR.colorBlocking: canvas, denim, cream, rust, or colorful work cloth
WORKWEAR_FARMWEAR.directionRule: pockets are front-only; yoke wraps to back
WORKWEAR_FARMWEAR.identityWithoutColor: collar, placket, rolled cuff, and paired pockets

STREETWEAR.silhouette: relaxed, cropped, or asymmetric upper mass
STREETWEAR.necklineCollar: hood, high collar, or asymmetric opening
STREETWEAR.sleeves: long with deliberate cuff or stripe
STREETWEAR.pocketsPanels: pouch, side panel, or one offset panel
STREETWEAR.colorBlocking: light, saturated, pastel, or dark stories all valid
STREETWEAR.directionRule: asymmetry resolves to one side and simplifies on back
STREETWEAR.identityWithoutColor: volume, opening rhythm, cuff, and offset panel

HOODIE_SWEATWEAR.necklineCollar: hood ring with visible back/side depth
HOODIE_SWEATWEAR.directionRule: hood mass persists in all views; pouch terminates at sides

KNIT_CARDIGAN.silhouette: soft continuous knit or open cardigan
KNIT_CARDIGAN.necklineCollar: crew, high, shawl, or open knit edge
KNIT_CARDIGAN.openingClosure: closed knit or full open front
KNIT_CARDIGAN.pocketsPanels: small lower pockets only when cardigan-led
KNIT_CARDIGAN.trimPatternMotif: cable, plaid, yoke band, or edge ribbing
KNIT_CARDIGAN.colorBlocking: pastel, bright, earthy, and neutral all valid
KNIT_CARDIGAN.directionRule: knit band wraps; cardigan opening compresses at side
KNIT_CARDIGAN.identityWithoutColor: substantial neck/open edge and repeated knit rhythm

FORMAL_SUIT.necklineCollar: lapel, shirt collar, tie, or bow hierarchy
FORMAL_SUIT.pocketsPanels: breast welt or restrained pocket square
FORMAL_SUIT.trimPatternMotif: fine piping, button rhythm, small textile repeat
FORMAL_SUIT.colorBlocking: light suits and colorful formal accents are valid
FORMAL_SUIT.directionRule: front hierarchy simplifies to back neck seam and jacket panel
FORMAL_SUIT.identityWithoutColor: lapel, shirt triangle, tie, and tailored hem

VEST_WAISTCOAT.silhouette: fitted outer torso over visible inner shirt
VEST_WAISTCOAT.shoulders: narrow vest edge with intact arm/sleeve relationship
VEST_WAISTCOAT.necklineCollar: deep V or high utility neck
VEST_WAISTCOAT.sleeves: inner-shirt sleeves or generated bare arms
VEST_WAISTCOAT.directionRule: front opening disappears; back retains vest panel and inner sleeve distinction
VEST_WAISTCOAT.identityWithoutColor: outer vest edges framing a distinct inner garment

JACKET_OUTERWEAR.silhouette: outer shell with visible opening and deliberate hem
JACKET_OUTERWEAR.shoulders: covered and structured without a full-width bar
JACKET_OUTERWEAR.trimPatternMotif: lapel trim, zipper, cuff, shoulder seam
JACKET_OUTERWEAR.directionRule: side reconstructs shell/opening; back uses one yoke gesture
JACKET_OUTERWEAR.identityWithoutColor: outer panels visibly wrap another garment

MILITARY_FIELDWEAR.layering: inner field shirt may remain visible
MILITARY_FIELDWEAR.trimPatternMotif: tabs, one harness rhythm, small abstract crest
MILITARY_FIELDWEAR.colorBlocking: tan, olive, cream, charcoal, and original alternatives
MILITARY_FIELDWEAR.directionRule: shoulder/yoke continues; pockets and insignia terminate
MILITARY_FIELDWEAR.identityWithoutColor: high collar, disciplined panels, pocket flaps, short waist

PERIOD_GENTLEMAN.necklineCollar: high collar, cravat, scarf, or layered lapel
PERIOD_GENTLEMAN.colorBlocking: cream and jewel accents may dominate
PERIOD_GENTLEMAN.directionRule: cravat is front-only; collar and back seam persist
PERIOD_GENTLEMAN.identityWithoutColor: high neck, cravat, offset buttons, layered formal planes

FANTASY_ADVENTURER.silhouette: fitted practical tunic or layered field top
FANTASY_ADVENTURER.shoulders: one reinforced or wrapped shoulder is allowed
FANTASY_ADVENTURER.necklineCollar: V, high undershirt, or wrap neck
FANTASY_ADVENTURER.pocketsPanels: utility pouch suggestion or reinforced panel
FANTASY_ADVENTURER.trimPatternMotif: rune-like abstract geometry, sash, leather piping
FANTASY_ADVENTURER.colorBlocking: earth, jewel, pastel-magic, and bright heraldic stories valid
FANTASY_ADVENTURER.directionRule: sash crosses front-to-side and resolves into a quiet back belt
FANTASY_ADVENTURER.identityWithoutColor: layered V, sash, belt, and reinforced shoulder

ARMOR_TUNIC_TABARD.silhouette: segmented upper armor framing a cloth center
ARMOR_TUNIC_TABARD.shoulders: small plate caps, never giant shoulder blocks
ARMOR_TUNIC_TABARD.openingClosure: center tabard rather than shirt placket
ARMOR_TUNIC_TABARD.hem: belted tabard termination inside safe upper footprint
ARMOR_TUNIC_TABARD.trimPatternMotif: rivets as connected pairs, heraldic abstract crest
ARMOR_TUNIC_TABARD.colorBlocking: metal, cloth, leather, and heraldic accent separate by value
ARMOR_TUNIC_TABARD.directionRule: plate shoulder and belt persist; front crest reduces to back tabard cue
ARMOR_TUNIC_TABARD.identityWithoutColor: segmentation, shoulder caps, guarded neck, center tabard

UNIFORM.sleeves: fitted long or rolled work sleeve
UNIFORM.layering: single uniform layer or visible undershirt
UNIFORM.trimPatternMotif: rank-like abstract bars, piping, restrained badge
UNIFORM.colorBlocking: high-value uniforms are as valid as dark ones
UNIFORM.directionRule: front insignia is omitted on back; yoke and piping continue
UNIFORM.identityWithoutColor: ordered collar, closure, shoulder, and chest geometry

ALT_DARK_FASHION.shoulders: one panel may dominate without exposing body
ALT_DARK_FASHION.sleeves: long with stripe, cuff, or inner-layer contrast
ALT_DARK_FASHION.hem: short structured or asymmetric suggestion within safe bounds
ALT_DARK_FASHION.pocketsPanels: offset panel rather than paired workwear pockets
ALT_DARK_FASHION.trimPatternMotif: geometric mark, buckle hint, piping, controlled chains
ALT_DARK_FASHION.colorBlocking: bright, pastel, or berry accents may replace all-black styling
ALT_DARK_FASHION.directionRule: dominant diagonal resolves on one side; back uses a reduced shoulder cue

corpusPolicy.primary: Non-Mixed packs define masculine article and silhouette evidence.
corpusPolicy.mixed: Only individually reviewed masculine-suitable or neutral garments may influence article grammar; other garments teach technique only.
corpusPolicy.generationBoundary: Benchmark and vanilla PNGs are never read by generation code.
